gap: No result ChatGPT got states what each 3-channel camera's parking mode costs on top of the camera, or today's maker-store prices: the Vantrue N4 Pro S is $279.99 on vantrue.com and its compatible hardwire kit is $29.99, while the VIOFO A329S 3CH is back to $519.99 on viofo.com (Product Bible and DashCamTalk say $429.99), needs a $25.99 HK6 kit for parking mode, and records its front camera at 30 fps once all three cameras run.
standout_why: Checked against Product Bible (cited, updated 2026-11-19), DashCamTalk best-dash-cams (cited) and ChatGPT's own cards. Product Bible prices the A329S 3CH at $429.99 and the T330 3CH at $419.99 as VIOFO sale prices, and says 'Hardwire kit not stated' for every Vantrue row. It never gives a kit price. DashCamTalk lists the A329S at $429.99 and the T800 at $299.99, and says nothing about kit prices or the front frame rate with three cameras recording. ChatGPT showed the N4 Pro S at $339.99 and the N4S at $179.99. Neither figure matches vantrue.com today ($279.99 and $199.99). Product Bible does note that the A329S 3CH front is 4K 30 fps, so that part is only partly new.
decides: This supports the N4 Pro S as the value pick and keeps the A329S 3CH as the best-quality pick. Today the two are $240 apart at the maker stores before kits ($279.99 against $519.99, read 2026-11-21). Both front cameras record 4K at 30 fps in 3-channel mode, because the A329S drops from 60 fps once its third camera is connected. What the extra money buys is the A329S's 2K 210° IR cabin camera (the N4 Pro S cabin is 1080p) and SSD storage up to 4 TB. Both need a hardwire kit for parking mode, at roughly the same price ($25.99 VIOFO HK6, $29.99 Vantrue). Vantrue therefore honestly places in the top three, as best value. The N4S ($199.99) is the budget 3-channel pick, but its front camera is not 4K.
